novelty.cross_GQA: Closed map2 was q.roll(2),k.roll(2) over original native learned maps, no new projection coordinates. New map2 has learned down/up Q/K matrices independent of all native head Q/K matrices; not a head permutation or output mixing.
novelty.headwise_gate: Closed sigmoid output gate scales an existing head vector. New map2 can select a different combination of original V vectors and create an output not collinear with native output; prove counterexample before GPU.
novelty.forgetting: Closed cumulative log gates changed native function at conversion and required two new matched arms. This variant is exactly native at raw coefficient0; cached native CE is eligible ONLY after actual initial state/function/stream/optimizer protocol proof.
novelty.context_mixing: Closed condition was greedy input replacement/scheduled sampling. New variant keeps every original input and label unchanged and adds an explicit attention information path.

cache: New typed cache stores real original K1/V plus real K2, validity and positions; incremental decoding computes only current states. No canonical/tiled source/cache migration or past recomputation.
formula: For each layer: U=Xnorm Wdown(rank8); Q2=RoPE(U Wq2), K2=RoPE(U Wk2); A1=original_SDPA(Q1,K1,V), A2=SDPA(Q2,K2,V); output=O(A1-tanh(raw_h)*A2). Original Q1/K1/V/O/NoQKNorm/RoPE remain. Same causal/padding rules for both maps.

training.backend: Existing FLASH/BF16 CUDA full-prefix ordinary SDPA twice; FP32/MATH inference. No arbitrary differentiable mask or new dependency.
